title: Star Course
core_verb: Run and double-jump across floating platforms to collect every star and reach the goal.
fantasy: A mascot-style platformer set on a floating course of bright platforms high above a void.
fail_state: You fall through the void below the course, or your health reaches zero after touching a hazard three times.
win_state: Land on the goal platform after collecting all 6 stars on the course.

interaction_tags.meaning: Hazard that removes one of 3 health on contact.
Collectible placed around the course; collecting all 6 is the first win clause.
Goal platform; landing on it after collecting every star wins.

notes: The hub-and-star adventure is reduced to one fixed platform course with 6 stars and a goal platform: collect, then land on the goal. Three health points make hazard contact a real loss path without any enemy AI.

scene.description: A bright floating sky course of gray and white platforms over a bottomless blue void, a glowing gold goal platform at the far end. Stars spin above gaps and ledges, spiked hazards stud the mid-course, and floating rocks line the approach. Moderate: enough platforms to keep a running double-jump flowing without hunting for the next foothold.
